trans-unit.resname: Automatic WebP for banners and sliders
trans-unit.source: Automatic WebP for banners and sliders
trans-unit.target: WebP automático para banners y sliders

trans-unit.resname: Creates the WebP copy of every banner, slider and image that is uploaded or changed, and serves it to the browsers that accept it.
trans-unit.source: Creates the WebP copy of every banner, slider and image that is uploaded or changed, and serves it to the browsers that accept it.
trans-unit.target: Crea la copia WebP de cada banner, slider e imagen que se sube o se cambia, y la entrega a los navegadores que la aceptan.

trans-unit.resname: WebP created: %creados%, remade because their image changed: %rehechos%, left without WebP because it would weigh more: %sinventaja%, errors: %errores%.
trans-unit.source: WebP created: %creados%, remade because their image changed: %rehechos%, left without WebP because it would weigh more: %sinventaja%, errors: %errores%.
trans-unit.target: WebP creados: %creados%; rehechos porque su imagen cambió: %rehechos%; sin WebP porque pesaría más: %sinventaja%; errores: %errores%.

trans-unit.resname: Some are still missing: press the button again.
trans-unit.source: Some are still missing: press the button again.
trans-unit.target: Aún faltan algunos: pulsa otra vez el botón.

trans-unit.resname: The .htaccess file could not be written: the server will not deliver the WebP files.
trans-unit.source: The .htaccess file could not be written: the server will not deliver the WebP files.
trans-unit.target: No se ha podido escribir el .htaccess: el servidor no entregará los WebP.

trans-unit.resname: Settings saved.
Create WebP automatically
When an image is uploaded or changed in the back office, its WebP copy is created.
trans-unit.source: When an image is uploaded or changed in the back office, its WebP copy is created.
trans-unit.target: Cuando se sube o se cambia una imagen en el back-office, se crea su copia WebP.

trans-unit.resname: Deliver the WebP to browsers that accept it
trans-unit.source: Deliver the WebP to browsers that accept it
trans-unit.target: Entregar el WebP a los navegadores que lo aceptan

trans-unit.resname: Adds a rule to the .htaccess file: the page keeps asking for the JPG or PNG and the server sends the WebP.
trans-unit.source: Adds a rule to the .htaccess file: the page keeps asking for the JPG or PNG and the server sends the WebP.
trans-unit.target: Añade una regla al .htaccess: la página sigue pidiendo el JPG o el PNG y el servidor envía el WebP.

trans-unit.resname: From 40 to 100. 82 is a good balance.
trans-unit.source: From 40 to 100. 82 is a good balance.
trans-unit.target: De 40 a 100. Con 82 se consigue un buen equilibrio.

trans-unit.resname: Folders to watch
One per line, from the shop root. Ending in /* means only that folder, without subfolders.
trans-unit.source: One per line, from the shop root. Ending in /* means only that folder, without subfolders.
trans-unit.target: Una por línea, desde la raíz de la tienda. Si acaba en /*, solo esa carpeta, sin subcarpetas.

Only for shops where PrestaShop does not create them (1.7, or 8 and 9 without the WebP format active).

trans-unit.target: Solo en tiendas donde PrestaShop no las crea (1.7, o 8 y 9 sin el formato WebP activo).

trans-unit.source: There is a newer version of this module. Contact support to update it.
trans-unit.target: Hay una versión más reciente de este módulo. Contacta con soporte para actualizarlo.

trans-unit.resname: WebP status
The settings are common to all shops: the image files are shared.
trans-unit.source: The settings are common to all shops: the image files are shared.
trans-unit.target: La configuración es común a todas las tiendas: los ficheros de imagen son compartidos.

trans-unit.target: Falta la regla del .htaccess y no se ha podido escribir: los navegadores siguen recibiendo JPG y PNG.

trans-unit.resname: Last automatic check:
The server delivers WebP:
Help: how it works

When an image is uploaded or changed in the back office (sliders, banners, CMS pages, categories, brands...), its WebP copy is created at the end of that same request, next to the original and with the same name.
trans-unit.source: When an image is uploaded or changed in the back office (sliders, banners, CMS pages, categories, brands...), its WebP copy is created at the end of that same request, next to the original and with the same name.
trans-unit.target: Cuando se sube o se cambia una imagen en el back-office (sliders, banners, páginas CMS, categorías, marcas...), su copia WebP se crea al terminar esa misma petición, junto a la original y con el mismo nombre.

trans-unit.resname: Product photos are not touched: PrestaShop 8 and 9 create them when the WebP format is active in Design > Image settings.
trans-unit.source: Product photos are not touched: PrestaShop 8 and 9 create them when the WebP format is active in Design > Image settings.
trans-unit.target: Las fotos de producto no se tocan: PrestaShop 8 y 9 las crea cuando el formato WebP está activo en Diseño > Ajustes de imágenes.

trans-unit.resname: The originals are never modified or deleted. If an image changes, its WebP is created again.
trans-unit.source: The originals are never modified or deleted. If an image changes, its WebP is created again.
trans-unit.target: Las originales nunca se modifican ni se borran. Si una imagen cambia, su WebP se vuelve a crear.

trans-unit.resname: No gain: its WebP would weigh more than the image, or there is another image with the same name (logo.jpg and logo.png). Those keep being served as they are.
trans-unit.source: No gain: its WebP would weigh more than the image, or there is another image with the same name (logo.jpg and logo.png). Those keep being served as they are.
trans-unit.target: Sin ventaja: su WebP pesaría más que la imagen, o hay otra imagen con el mismo nombre (logo.jpg y logo.png). Esas se siguen entregando tal cual.

trans-unit.resname: The page keeps asking for the JPG or PNG; the .htaccess rule sends the WebP only to browsers that accept it, so no template has to be changed.
trans-unit.source: The page keeps asking for the JPG or PNG; the .htaccess rule sends the WebP only to browsers that accept it, so no template has to be changed.
trans-unit.target: La página sigue pidiendo el JPG o el PNG; la regla del .htaccess envía el WebP solo a los navegadores que lo aceptan, así que no hay que cambiar ninguna plantilla.
